sentences.text: Aleister Crowley -LRB- -LSB- ˈkroʊli -RSB- born Edward Alexander Crowley ; 12 October 1875 -- 1 December 1947 -RRB- was an English occultist , ceremonial magician , poet , painter , novelist , and mountaineer .	novelist	novelist	poet	poetry	painter	painting	mountaineer	mountaineering
He founded the religion of Thelema , identifying himself as the prophet entrusted with guiding humanity into the Æon of Horus in the early 20th century .	Thelema	Thelema	Æon of Horus	Aeon (Thelema)
A prolific writer , he published widely over the course of his life .

Born to a wealthy Plymouth Brethren family in Royal Leamington Spa , Warwickshire , Crowley rejected this fundamentalist Christian faith to pursue an interest in Western esotericism .	Royal Leamington Spa	Royal Leamington Spa	Warwickshire	Warwickshire	Plymouth Brethren	Plymouth Brethren	fundamentalist Christian	Christian fundamentalism	Western esotericism	Western esotericism
He was educated at the University of Cambridge , where he focused his attentions on mountaineering and poetry , resulting in several publications .	University of Cambridge	University of Cambridge

Some biographers allege that here he was recruited into a British intelligence agency , further suggesting that he remained a spy throughout his life .	British intelligence agency	List of intelligence agencies of the United Kingdom

In 1898 he joined the esoteric Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn , where he was trained in ceremonial magic by Samuel Liddell MacGregor Mathers and Allan Bennett .	ceremonial magic	ceremonial magic	Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn	Hermetic Order of the Golden Dawn	Samuel Liddell MacGregor Mathers	Samuel Liddell MacGregor Mathers	Allan Bennett	Charles Henry Allan Bennett

Moving to Boleskine House by Loch Ness in Scotland , he went mountaineering in Mexico with Oscar Eckenstein , before studying Hindu and Buddhist practices in India .	Boleskine House	Boleskine House	Loch Ness	Loch Ness	Oscar Eckenstein	Oscar Eckenstein	Hindu	Hinduism	Buddhist	Buddhism

He married Rose Edith Kelly and in 1904 they honeymooned in Cairo , Egypt , where Crowley claimed to have been contacted by a supernatural entity named Aiwass , who provided him with The Book of the Law , a sacred text that served as the basis for Thelema .	Rose Edith Kelly	Rose Edith Kelly	Thelema	Thelema	Cairo	Cairo	Aiwass	Aiwass	The Book of the Law	The Book of the Law

Announcing the start of the Æon of Horus , The Book declared that its followers should `` Do what thou wilt '' and seek to align themselves with their True Will through the practice of magick .	Æon of Horus	Aeon (Thelema)	True Will	True Will	magick	Magick (Thelema)

After an unsuccessful attempt to climb Kanchenjunga and a visit to India and China , Crowley returned to Britain , where he attracted attention as a prolific author of poetry , novels , and occult literature .	occult	occult	an unsuccessful attempt to climb Kanchenjunga	1905 Kanchenjunga expedition
In 1907 , he and George Cecil Jones co-founded a Thelemite order , the A ∴ A ∴ , through which they propagated the religion .	George Cecil Jones	George Cecil Jones

After spending time in Algeria , in 1912 he was initiated into another esoteric order , the German-based Ordo Templi Orientis -LRB- O.T.O. -RRB- , rising to become the leader of its British branch , which he reformulated in accordance with his Thelemite beliefs .	Ordo Templi Orientis	Ordo Templi Orientis
Through the O.T.O. , Thelemite groups were established in Britain , Australia , and North America .

Crowley spent the First World War in the United States , where he took up painting and campaigned for the German war effort against Britain , later revealing that he had infiltrated the pro-German movement to assist the British intelligence services .	First World War	First World War
In 1920 he established the Abbey of Thelema , a religious commune in Cefalù , Sicily where he lived with various followers .	Thelema	Thelema	Abbey of Thelema	Abbey of Thelema	Cefalù	Cefalù
His libertine lifestyle led to denunciations in the British press , and the Italian government evicted him in 1923 .	libertine	libertine
He divided the following two decades between France , Germany , and England , and continued to promote Thelema until his death .	Thelema	Thelema

Crowley gained widespread notoriety during his lifetime , being a recreational drug experimenter , bisexual and an individualist social critic .	recreational drug experimenter	recreational drug use	bisexual	bisexual	individualist	Individualism	social critic	social criticism
He was denounced in the popular press as `` the wickedest man in the world '' and a Satanist .	Satanist	Satanist

Crowley has remained a highly influential figure over Western esotericism and the counter-culture , and continues to be considered a prophet in Thelema .	Thelema	Thelema	Western esotericism	Western esotericism
In 2002 , a BBC poll ranked him as the seventy-third greatest Briton of all time .	BBC	BBC	greatest Briton of all time	100 Greatest Britons
